tweets.text:
Think oil deserves more attention if you’re watching stocks and crypto right now.

US - Iran tensions and attacks on Russian energy facilities could keep supply under pressure. Trump waiving the new Russia sanctions could offer some relief, but it doesn’t undo the disruption.

US inflation came in at 3.7% in September. 
If energy stays expensive, businesses face higher costs, consumers have less to spend, and the Fed has less room to lower rates. That could keep pressure on stocks and make it harder for a crypto rally to hold.

The opposite matters too. If supply improves and oil comes down, both markets could get some breathing room before the geopolitical situation is fully resolved.

With midterms on November 3, there’s an incentive for Trump to push for lower prices. But I wouldn’t build a bullish case purely around “he needs markets up.”

For me, the question is whether these talks and policy changes actually make energy cheaper. That would give a recovery more substance than another reassuring headline.

tweets.text:
Think this is about the 3rd or 4th time just this year that people call for a "Black Monday".

As far as I know, those previous cases BTC front ran that by dumping during the weekend. Hence, making the case for a weak stock market on Monday more sense.

In this case not much is happening and I feel like it's just a lot of fear from the past few days of price action in especially the stock market.

If this year has shown us anything it is that markets really don't care about whatever is going on (to a certain extend).

Especially crypto has not been reacting to headlines and has been doing its own thing the past few months.

Correlation traders have been getting washed out during this time as well.

Over the months there have been just as many days that BTC was "correlated" to the Nasdaq 100 as days it was reversely correlated. So that says a lot.

Obviously if stocks crater deep then yes, BTC will see some weakness too. But I think these calls for "Black Monday" are super exaggerated. Keep in mind this definition was created in 1987 when the Dow dropped -22% in a single day.

People love naming previous big events to current situations and it never happens in the same way, especially when many call it beforehand.

I don't know what color Monday's candle will be but all the fear mongering going on just seems excessive at this point.

Just draw your high timeframe levels, sit back and relax. Don't overleverage (ever), have cash on the side and see how the market develops.

tweets.text:
$BTC Chopping around during the weekend with some local liquidity sweeps.

But the $83K+ area remains untested and there's still ample short liquidity in that region.

I think even in a bearish next week scenario, it would make sense for price to take out those positions.

If you see a squeeze into that region and BTC failing to retake $84K+ it could be a decent short trigger.

But I do believe if price trades into that area it will squeeze higher with the fuel it has.

Downside invalidation is sub $80K. At that point we can start preparing for a bleed lower to $75K & $72K as major high timeframe levels.

Just playing things level by level here.

quote.text:
$BTC Still yet to really test the shorts that came in above the $82K region after the hot CPI report on Wednesday.

I suspect price will start squeezing once it tests the entry of the majority of those shorts in the white box. Because most of those positions are still comfortably in profit as we speak.

That fuel should help to push this above last week's highs.

Dream scenario for the bulls would be to do this today but it might be a bit too much to ask right before the weekend.

On the downside, you don't want to start losing ~$81K because at that point this move up will just fully retrace in a Bart move.

But with all the equal highs right above I think from a liquidity standpoint that $83K+ area makes sense to test,

#Bitcoin – What’s Next?

The Big Sunday Report: All We Need to Know

TA / LCA / Psychological Breakdown:

Bitcoin is now in a very interesting fractal, and the dump that is happening right now is based on the bearish divergence I warned would occur at $87,000. This is why I was bearish in the short term last month, calling for $79K, and turned bullish again two weeks ago at 80k, as I consider the correction completed. In my view, that correction was needed to reset several on-chain indicators, as well as the RSI, with the bearish divergence playing out exactly as I had been expecting. So now we are in a very interesting formation: during the last bearish divergence, Bitcoin corrected down to the ORANGE line and bounced from there. This time, following the CURRENT bearish divergence, BTC once again dropped to the ORANGE line, and it looks like it will bounce from here once again. This is why I have entered a long position with 4× leverage at $81,000 

Now look at the DAILY RSI on my chart. It has returned to the highlighted region where the previous bounce happened. BTC is testing the ORANGE line once again, and the last time it happened it marked the local bottom. This is the similarity I want you to understand! At $87K, price was pushing higher while the RSI was making lower highs. That was my warning when I said clearly that I want to short. Back then everyone was calling for 100k and the sentiment was euphoric,  Now price has corrected, the RSI has cooled, and both are back at the areas I am watching for a recovery, and the sentiment is very negative, means people are scared to buy, also due to the recent LEDGER news, and fear of a new War.

My next Bitcoin target remains $94,000! This time, I expect accumulation instead of distribution, in the area of 86-88k, with buyers absorbing the selling and turning resistance into support. And this will be the reason that brings BTC to 94k, For now, I see the current levels of 81-82k as strong support, and I would not bet against those levels, instead, I am accumulating as I consider these levels the local bottom. Also one very important level is $82,000. The reason can be found in the Sunday Reports I have shared 1-2 Months ago, 82k is a very important resistance zone and breaking it would mean the start of the bull market. We have already broken it, went into a correction now, and here we are, retesting the area of 82k. Relax, drink tea. I am betting on much higher targets for the coming weeks. The first step and confirmation is the reclaim of 82k, next is moving sideway, between 82k - 88k, and afterwards the breakout to 94k!
